summary: Cheche Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 35-for-1 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, approved by shareholders on June 12, 2026, effective July 20, 2026. The consolidation reduces outstanding shares from 69,093,430 to 1,974,098 Class A and from 18,596,504 to 531,328 Class B shares, with fractional shares rounded. Warrant adjustments are proportional. The move aims to regain Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance. No premium, acquisition, or special-situation event is involved; this is a routine capital structure adjustment with no material corporate action beyond bid compliance. Watch for Nasdaq confirmation and future price stability.
